parameters.content:
## Form + Gemini → CEKIVA

A form, one Gemini call and one CEKIVA request per network: Facebook Page, Instagram, LinkedIn, Threads and Bluesky. Free and open source (MIT). X (Twitter) is not included: CEKIVA retired that channel.

**1 · Credentials (3)**
• `CEKIVA API key` — Header Auth: header `Authorization`, value `Bearer tplk_...` (CEKIVA → Settings → API keys). Select it in **CEKIVA: POST /v1/posts**.
• `Gemini API key` — Header Auth: header `x-goog-api-key`, value = your key from Google AI Studio. Select it in **Gemini: write the copy**.
• `Form password` — Basic Auth, so that not everyone with the form's URL can publish on your accounts. Select it in **Post details**.

**2 · Options** — top of **Prepare Gemini request** (model, language, voice) and **Build CEKIVA posts** (publish now / schedule, link).

**Image.** Instagram needs an image: fill in *Image URL* (a public link) or Instagram is skipped. No image host is needed; CEKIVA fetches the link itself.
Posting costs CEKIVA credits (prices are shown in CEKIVA); the Gemini call is billed by Google.
